name: Mixture-of-Experts Neural Fields
definition: A mixture-of-experts approach routing coordinates through a policy network to one of seven expert decoders, each specializing in a spatially distinct subdomain, with a shared encoder.
summary: Mixture-of-Experts Neural Fields is a neural representation for scientific volume data that partitions the spatial domain into subdomains modeled by specialized expert decoders, distinguished by a shared encoder that ensures global boundary continuity.
